auth.ownPasswordHint: You signed in with a temporary password from your head. Set your own: at least 8 characters with letters and digits.

cart.categoryForbidden: This section is not open to your department. Ask the head to open it.
cart.requesterText: The purchaser sees them with your name, removes what is not needed and places the order. Track it in “My orders”.
cart.requestRemoved: {name}'s request was removed from the order

orders.placedHint: Placed and approved the order in the company

home.requestsText: Request what you need from your department's sections; the purchaser places the order

pdp.requestHint: The item goes as a request to your company's purchaser

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

presetText.owner: Everything: staff, roles, departments, balance, approving orders
presetText.purchaser: Sees everyone's requests, edits them and places the order
presetText.requester: Requests goods from their department's sections

catalog_all.title: Whole catalogue
catalog_all.text: Sees every section, not only their department's

requests_create.title: Requests
requests_create.text: Adds goods to the company cart under their name

requests_approve.title: Approve and order
requests_approve.text: Sees everyone's requests, removes what is not needed and places the order

orders_viewAll.title: All orders
orders_viewAll.text: Sees all company orders, not only those with their requests

balance_manage.title: Balance
balance_manage.text: Company balance, top-up invoices, bank details

staff_manage.title: Staff
staff_manage.text: Adds staff, roles, departments and opens sections

categories.applySuggested: Tick the ones for our activity code

credentials.title: Employee added
credentials.smsSent: The login and temporary password were sent by SMS to {phone}
credentials.note: The password is shown only now. The employee sets their own on first sign-in. Lost it? Issue a new one with the lock button.
credentials.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy it by hand.

employee.phoneHint: An SMS with the password will go to it
employee.phoneLocked: The login cannot change. For another number, add the employee again.
employee.departmentHint: The employee sees the catalogue sections open to the department
employee.seesAll: This role sees the whole catalogue; the department is just for order
employee.limitHint: Requests over the limit are not accepted
employee.extraHint: Just for this person, in addition to the department's sections
employee.smsNote: The employee gets the login and a temporary password by SMS. You will see them too.
employee.errorPhoneTaken: This number already belongs to another employee
employee.noDepartments: No departments yet: open sections to this person below or create departments.
employee.noLimitHint: The employee requests without an amount cap

role.title: Title
role.presetNote: A ready-made role; its permissions cannot change. Need a different set? Create your own role.
role.errorTitleTaken: A role with this title already exists

department.title: Title
department.categoriesHint: Department staff see and can request only these sections. The purchaser and head see the whole catalogue.
department.emptyWarning: No section is open: department staff will see nothing in the catalogue
department.errorTitleTaken: A department with this title already exists

company.title: Company
company.staffText: An employee's login is their phone. The password comes to them by SMS, and you see it too.
company.rolesText: A role is a set of permissions. There are ready-made roles, and you can build your own.
company.departmentsText: Each department gets its own sections: paper and stationery for accounting, equipment for IT.
company.noDepartments: No departments yet. Create the first one and open catalogue sections to it.
company.departmentsNote: You can open extra sections to a single person in their card.
company.detailsNote: These details came from the tax registry at registration. Bank details for top-ups are in “Company balance”.
company.noCategories: None yet: ask the head to open sections to your department
company.askHead: The head of the company changes your role, department and limit.

remove.employee: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. Their requests stay in the cart for the purchaser.
remove.role: The role “{name}” will be removed. This is only possible if nobody has it.
remove.department: The department “{name}” will be removed; its staff lose access to its sections.

company.roleInUse: Some employees have this role: change their role first
company.firstStaffHint: Add employees: each gets their own login, and their requests reach your cart with name and role.
company.quickStartText: Pick typical departments; catalogue sections are already chosen. Those matching activity code {code} are ticked.

register.title: Register your company
register.lead: Confirm the director with OneID or a digital signature key. We take company details from the tax registry; you only set a phone and a password.
register.privacy: We never store your signature key or OneID password: we only receive the confirmation and company details.
register.eimzoText: The organisation key in the E-IMZO app
register.oneIdHint: The OneID page will open. After you sign in we bring you back here with the company details.
register.noEimzo: Could not reach E-IMZO. Make sure the app is installed and running, then reload the page.
register.errorOneId: Could not sign in with OneID. Please try again.
register.errorSignature: The signature did not verify. Choose another key or try again.
register.alreadyText: You confirmed you are its director, so sign in as the head.
register.headPhoneHint: You will get SMS on it and use it to sign in
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with letters and digits
register.errorPhoneTaken: This number already belongs to an employee of another company
register.errorPassword: Password: at least 8 characters with letters and digits
register.errorExpired: The confirmation has expired. Please confirm your identity again.
register.errorGeneric: Could not register the company. Please try again.
register.doneText: {name} is on spotshop. You are the head: add employees, give them roles and open catalogue sections to departments.
register.suggestedText: They come first in the catalogue, and we will suggest them when you set up departments.
